Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The study focuses on the enrichment of exosome proteins within HCMV virions. While 'extracellular exosome' is a key target, it is used here as a biological classification of the proteins found in the virion/vesicle fractions rather than a specific PTM-enrichment chemistry (like anti-K-QQTGG). Therefore, no specific PTM modifier (like mod_sumo_qqtgg) is selected despite the ontology keyword match, as the method was density-gradient centrifugation of vesicles, not antibody-based remnant enrichment.
